cells.gaps: No law is enacted. The 2025 UPR report had a bill awaiting discussion in the Assembly (GNB-004); on 8 May 2026 the Council of Ministers approved the law with amendments still to be made (GNB-006), and no source says it has since gone to the Assembly. GNB-001 (22 September 2026) says no law exists. Regulations and application: nothing found.
cells.note: The strongest standing stated is tabled (GNB-004, 18 February 2025), and the newest a cabinet-approved bill under amendment (GNB-006, 8 May 2026); either is stage 2, and stage 3 needs an enacted law. The Council of Ministers' approval inside the twelve months is the advancing event.
